Round173D.genuine_interval_mellin_moment_bound.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (mu : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts mu] (h chi : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ)
  (hh : Continuous h) (hc : Continuous chi) (hs : HasCompactSupport h) (hu : ∀ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖chi x‖ = 1)
  (R alpha : ℝ) (_hR : 0 ≤ R) (ha : 0 ≤ alpha) (hr : ∀ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), h x ≠ 0 → |classLog K x| ≤ R) (z : ℂ)
  (hz : |z.re| ≤ alpha) (m : ℕ) :
  Integrable (mellinMomentIntegrand K h chi z m) mu ∧
    ‖∫ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), mellinMomentIntegrand K h chi z m x ∂mu‖ ≤
      Real.exp (alpha * R) * R ^ m * ∫ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖h x‖ ∂mu

Round173D.genuine_compact_interval_mellin_bound.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (mu : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts mu] (h : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous h)
  (hs : HasCompactSupport h) :
  ∃ R,
    1 ≤ R ∧
      ∀ (chi : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ),
        Continuous chi →
          (∀ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖chi x‖ = 1) →
            ∀ (alpha : ℝ),
              0 ≤ alpha →
                ∀ (z : ℂ),
                  |z.re| ≤ alpha →
                    ∀ (m : ℕ),
                      Integrable (mellinMomentIntegrand K h chi z m) mu ∧
                        ‖∫ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), mellinMomentIntegrand K h chi z m x ∂mu‖ ≤
                          Real.exp (alpha * R) * R ^ m * ∫ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖h x‖ ∂mu

  (mu : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts mu] (h : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous h)
  (hs : HasCompactSupport h) :

Round175D.genuine_mellin_iteratedDeriv.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (mu : Measure (HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts mu] (h chi : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ)
  (hh : Continuous h) (hc : Continuous chi) (hs : HasCompactSupport h) (hu : ∀ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖chi x‖ = 1)
  (m : ℕ) :
  (iteratedDeriv m fun z => ∫ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), mellinMomentIntegrand K h chi z 0 x ∂mu) = fun z =>
    ∫ (x : HeckeIdeleClasses K), mellinMomentIntegrand K h chi z m x ∂mu

Round176A.spectralJet_mul.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] (chi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K →* ℂ)
  (z : ℂ) (m : ℕ) (x y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K) :
  Round176A.spectralJet K chi z m (x * y) =
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      ↑(m.choose i) * Round176A.spectralJet K chi z i x * Round176A.spectralJet K chi z (m - i) y

Round176A.genuine_adjoint_spectral_jet_action.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts mu]
  (h : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (chi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K →* ℂ) (hh : Continuous h)
  (hc : Continuous ⇑chi) (hs : HasCompactSupport h) (hu : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖chi x‖ = 1) (z : ℂ)
  (m : ℕ) (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K) :
  Integrable (fun x => h x * Round176A.spectralJet K chi z m (x * y)) mu ∧
    ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), h x * Round176A.spectralJet K chi z m (x * y) ∂mu =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        ↑(m.choose i) * Round176A.spectralJet K chi z (m - i) y *
          iteratedDeriv i
            (fun w => ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Round173D.mellinMomentIntegrand K h (⇑chi) w 0 x ∂mu) z

  [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] (h f : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ)
  (chi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K →* ℂ) (hh : Continuous h) (hf : Continuous f) (hc : Continuous ⇑chi)
  (hs : HasCompactSupport h) (fs : HasCompactSupport f) (hu : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖chi x‖ = 1)
  (z : ℂ) (m : ℕ) :
  Integrable (fun y => Round177A.classConvolution K mu h f y * Round176A.spectralJet K chi z m y) mu ∧
    ∫ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
        Round177A.classConvolution K mu h f y * Round176A.spectralJet K chi z m y ∂mu =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        ↑(m.choose i) *
            iteratedDeriv i
              (fun w => ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Round173D.mellinMomentIntegrand K h (⇑chi) w 0 x ∂mu)
              z *
          ∫ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), f y * Round176A.spectralJet K chi z (m - i) y ∂mu
